meta.parties: Jandiris Et Al. v. Deve Renta Et Al

rules.statement: The plaintiffs are entitled to a five-twelfths share of the land, and the thirteenth defendant is also entitled to share as claimed by him.
rules.supporting_quote: "Appeal allowed with costs. The case is to go back to the learned District Judge with the declaration that Mendiris was entitled to a five-twelfths share of the land and not to any less fraction, also with the declaration that the thirteenth defendant is entitled to share as claimed by him; likewise an order that the learned District Judge do allot shares on such basis."
